observation_model.coupling: latent states and actions are identical across eta levels; observation-noise streams are independent by eta and block

gate.acceptance: all observed outputs in the block must lie within eta + support_slack of the candidate conditional mean

analysis.primary_criterion: analytic conditional blind-pass probability at primary_eta minus its eta=0 value is at most primary_robustness_margin
analysis.boundary_definition: first prespecified eta whose analytic conditional blind-pass probability exceeds its eta=0 value by at least boundary_increase
analysis.interval: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson 95 percent interval over seed-block pass indicators
analysis.overlap_law: q(delta,eta)=1[delta=0] at eta=0; otherwise max(0,1-|delta|/(2 eta)); multiply q over outputs and transitions within a fixed block

scope.included: bounded observation noise with known iid law on one designed deterministic instrument and analytic truth/blind proxies
scope.excluded: process noise, unknown or heavy-tailed noise, new LLM synthesis, a new planner run, and an externally specified benchmark
